items.text: Cardinals say RB Jeremiyah Love is questionable to return today due to an ankle injury.
items.why: Ankle injury mid-game after being listed active.
items.implication: Monitor return; ARI RB depth tested if out for duration.

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled out with right thumb injury after exiting on first play; Tyler Huntley also ruled out with toe, undrafted Joe Fagnano enters as emergency QB.
items.why: Right thumb injury on first play of game vs Bills; Huntley toe injury follows.
items.implication: Ravens offense collapses to undrafted rookie; massive downgrade for BAL pass catchers and Henry; DFS/QB pivots needed immediately.

items.text: Breece Hall (quad) not expected to play today per RapSheet; Braelon Allen expected to start again.
items.why: Quad injury; limited practice and cryptic updates; confirmed not expected by Rapoport.
items.implication: Full workload for Braelon Allen as lead back vs Raiders; solid RB2 upside.

items.text: ACTIVE: DJ Moore, Dalton Kincaid, Aaron Jones and Jeremiyah Love. OUT: Breece Hall, Carnell Tate, Tajae Spears.
items.why: Official actives despite shoulder (Moore) and chest (Kincaid); Love active but later ankle QTR.
items.implication: BUF pass game stabilized; start Moore/Kincaid with confidence; Tate/Spears outs boost TEN others.

items.text: Actives today include George Pickens, DJ Moore, Dalton Kincaid, Jakobi Meyers, Calvin Ridley. Inactives: Breece Hall.
items.why: Shoulder issue cleared; expected to play and confirmed active.
items.implication: DAL WR1 viable; full routes expected vs ARI.

items.text: Really tough projection on Jonathan Taylor today amid trade rumors. Expected to start but if trading him makes zero sense to play; teams do insane stuff.
items.why: Colts open to trading JT; pregame reports say expected to start vs JAX but uncertainty high.
items.implication: Volatile start/sit; monitor for any late scratch or limited role. Trade value open.

items.text: Braelon Allen rides again as a solid RB2 on Breece Hall not expected news.
items.why: Hall out again; Allen has produced as starter with 100-yard games.
items.implication: Must-start RB2 vs soft Raiders run D.

items.text: AJ Brown OUT along with TreVeyon Henderson; listed in ETR weekend summary.
items.why: Lingering knee/ankle for Brown; illness for Henderson. Confirmed OUT in final reports.
items.implication: Patriots WR depth thins; targets to other NE receivers; Henderson handcuff irrelevant.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle (chest) trending in the right direction to play, source says.
items.why: Chest injury aggravated last week but trending positive; ETR lists expected.
items.implication: DEN WR viable; with Harvey IR, more targets available in DEN offense.
items.opportunity: Waddle routes/targets up if full; DEN backfield/targets free from Harvey

items.text: RJ Harvey (knee) OUT/IR; role so unique no clean handcuff/replacement but 3-6 more targets now available. Waddle also Q.
items.why: Knee; placed on IR designated to return. Unique usage leaves targets free.
items.implication: DEN targets redistribute (Waddle primary beneficiary if plays); no direct RB handcuff.
items.opportunity: 3-6 extra targets in DEN pass game

items.text: Weird practice for Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle LP-LP-DNP out of bye). Given that and BTJ situation, perhaps season-high routes for Travis Hunter.
items.why: Meyers practice pattern odd; opportunity for Hunter routes spike.
items.implication: Hunter flex/WR3 upside in deeper leagues if routes materialize vs IND.

items.text: Shocked Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) wasn't on final injury report. Hard to believe he's 100%, but he's playing.
items.why: Surprising omission from final report despite prior issues; not fully healthy likely.
items.implication: Start but with slight dock; monitor pregame for any limitations. Eagles won't trade him.
items.conflict: Usage may be managed despite active

items.text: Braelon Allen HAS BEEN DIFFERENT. Running to size & power; proving Jets should listen to offers for Breece Hall.
items.why: In-game performance showing power/size; sustained production while Hall out.
items.implication: Allen RB2 lock; Hall trade rumors possible long-term.

items.text: Parlay includes Tee Higgins (more targets than Chase lately; TEN 2nd best matchup for perimeter WRs), Parker Washington (slot vs Colts soft), Dallas Goedert (WSH brutal vs TE; 20% share no Smith/Wicks).
items.why: Usage/matchup edges: Higgins target share edge, Washington slot, Goedert volume with absences.
items.implication: Strong start/sit or DFS lean for these three.
items.opportunity: Higgins targets > Chase recently; Goedert 20% share

items.text: EXPECTED TO PLAY: Colston Loveland among others including Jadarian Price, Zach Charbonnet, Kenny Gainwell.
items.implication: CHI TE viable; SEA/TB RBs full roles.

items.text: OUT includes Emeka Egbuka, Carnell Tate, Tyjae Spears among others; fallout for teammates.
items.why: Egbuka foot; Tate and Spears confirmed OUT in reports/Berry actives.
items.implication: TB/TEN WR/RB targets redistribute; Ridley expected boosts for TEN.

items.text: DeVonta Smith OUT (hamstring) along with Dontayvion Wicks; boosts Goedert etc.
items.why: Hamstring; confirmed in ETR OUT list and reports.
items.implication: PHI targets to Goedert/Brown/others; Goedert must-start.

items.text: Lamar Jackson (ankle) isn't on final report but smallish docks on his rushing in projections.
items.why: Returning from ankle but rushing volume tempered in models pre-thumb injury.
items.implication: Still high-end QB but ceiling capped slightly on ground; later thumb OUT overrides.
